test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

If __you do not followed the rules__, you will not be allowed to stay at this hostel.

options.text: If you do not follow the rules
If you cannot be following the rules
If you should not follow the rules

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb tense "**do not followed**".
 
• The correct form should be present tense, "**do not follow**."
 
• The phrase should correctly read as "**If you do not follow the rules**."
 
• Thus, the underlined segment needs to be substituted with **Option 2**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"If you do not follow the rules, you will not be allowed to stay at this hostel."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "No substitution"** – This option is incorrect because there is an error in the sentence.
 
• **3: "If you cannot be following the rules"** – This option is incorrect as it is not grammatically appropriate for this context.
 
• **4: "If you should not follow the rules"** – This option is incorrect because it changes the intended meaning of the sentence.
